Definition: to spread out (i.e. deploy in hostile array); by analogy, to strip (i.e. unclothe, plunder, flay, etc.)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to strip, invade, strip off, make a dash, raid, spread out; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to strip off, put off; 1a2) to put off (one's shelter), make a dash; 1b) (Piel) to strip; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to strip of; 1c2) to strip off; 1c3) to flay; 1d) (Hithpael) to strip oneself of
